text: Very impressed to call at 530 on a friday and be able to get an appointment 20m later. Would recommend Southam Surgery.

I asked the receptionist face to face for a GP appointment at some point in the next week or so. No privacy when asked to explain why. Then only offered triage. This is not a robust, supportive or a accommodating service.  it appears to be too much to expect to achieve a non emergency appointment with a GP and discuss with them only my reason for requesting an appointment. I cannot stuck on a phone for two hours in the hope of getting an appointment, this is unachievable, which is why I visited your reception.

I've had a very quick and efficient experience since recently being diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes.

Two appointments within a week and both nurses were very friendly and knowledgeable and gave me plenty of time to ask questions.
The Dr, surgery pharmacist and secretary were amazing and helpful in sorting out information I needed and getting medication that had been discontinued and needed something new urgently.

I am waiting for urgent eye surgery and require blood tests in order to proceed. Upon trying to arrange an urgent blood test the surgery has decided that their requirements are more important than my need for urgent surgery and have told me i have to wait for three months before they will arrange the test. This is very unhelpful and only decreases further my quality of life.
Not at all what is expected of the NHS
My husband and I find the service provided at Whiteacres Medical Centre excellent from receptionists to nurses to Gp’s.  We feel very reassured and safe to be in their hands.  Thank you

Had to see the GP today at the Water Eaton site for some results, didn’t wait long to see her, the doctor was very helpful, cheerful and friendly put me at ease straight away, also the reception staff were very helpful and friendly too, the only problem might be seeing the same GP for a follow up consultation.

I can wholeheartedly recommend this great practise. It’s like the hood old days ! I was with Helios, Stoke Bishop and moved here when they closed.  I was very dubious to begin with and it’s a good twenty minute drive.  It is worth every minute and plenty more.  Appointments always available.  I feel cared for and safe with a complicated medical history.  The reception team, nurses and doctors all really try their best and are incredibly pleasant .  The extra mile !

Feel disappointed, turn up the appointment on 26/8 and was told being canceled on 22/8 without notice.
But we had called on 24/8 about the appointment and no one told us being canceled.
Please respect other people.
I need to get my holiday to go with my mum’s appointment.

I booked for a telephone consultation for 3:30 pm. Waited for awhile. No calls received.  So I rang the surgery. I was told that I have to wait between 3:30 and 6:30 pm. Why bother having a time slot appointment? Receptionist was miserable on the phone.

I attended the surgery today fit and well to have a routine blood test.  Upon leaving the surgery I suddenly felt very unwell, shaky, chest pains, racing heart.  After staying for a few minutes in my car and not feeling any better I returned to the surgery to explain how unwell I felt and by this time anxious.  The receptionist was absolutely brilliant, she recognised immediately I needed medical help, within what felt like seconds a medical team was attending to me, got me into the treatment room, an immediate aspirin administered and ECG undertaken.  Throughout this time the receptionist held my hand and was reassuring.  Fortunately all tests were normal and after half an hour or so I felt much better with my heart rate down, pulse returning to normal and chest pain subsiding.  I wish to say a big thank you to the team who assisted me this morning - you were all brilliant.

Got in touch by phone re a chest / coughing problem.  Telephone screening appointment later that morning leading to a face to face appointment early evening.  Saw a clinician; diagnosed and prescribed anti-biotics which I was taking by early evening.  Great service.  Have also recently used the MC website for an online consultation leading to an appointment being arranged in two weeks time; convenient for both MC and me.  Very good service all round.

I requested my Gp to refer me to midwife, as i conceived with PCOS, and i was conscious about my Pregnancy and loss... But she did'nt and advised for Self-referral, for the self referral, i waited for 1.5 months for the 1st appointment. As a result, i ended to miscarriage. If in the initial stage, blood tests could done, so may be they able to see the problems, and they could provide any medicine to overcome any loss... But they did'nt, Now after the loss, m mentally depressed, and losing my health. Why they ignored me? In 2022, they did'nt give proper treatment to me, i had no periods for three months, but it was normal for them... Blood tests done, but no satisfactory treatment given to me, and for the Scan, very late referral given...
GP speaks my language. Quick phone answer. easy to get medicines. Receptionist good and care us. Good working staff
I cannot recommend this practice highly enough. Same day appointment given, excellent, helpful advice given by associate practitioner - truly wonderful service all round. Thank you Walnut Tree.

I received a letter from practice managers to advise I would receive a response regarding my complaint on the 30/6, I still have not received a response and I am still left untreated and without answers. This is a poor complaints procedure considering I made my complaint more than 2 months ago!

I have been left untreated after a cancelled operation for over a year. Burntwood Health And Wellbeing seem to not want to help patients let alone deal with existing health problems.

Poor service, Poor treatment, Poor communication and general neglect.

Waiting for them to answer call 1 hour
If you do get in the doctor doesn't seem interested in what you have to say rushed in and rushed out
I found blood in my poo, rang doctors was seen by doctor, had blood test, poo test, and phone appointment from Worthing hospital all within 3 weeks, thankfully all test was clear

Online booking of specific time of GP call. After an hour I contacted surgery, receptionist rude and told me it’s a 3 hr slot when I tried to explain perhaps change this so it states this online, she told me to calm down?! No apology from this surgery, still no call from GP after the 3hr time slot. Complete waste of space. Perhaps if receptionists are more empathetic and apologetic (well general customer service) they wouldn’t receive irate patients!

The costumers service was really bad the receptionist was really horrible she was really rude..... and that way ?? Because I am not British?? Or Because she couldn't want to try to understand me ??? I don't really know but still that is not normal I wanted to book call appointments and she forced me to do it online I can't do it on line I told her amd she didn't care so she close the phone and I was still speaking to her trying to explain her my situation that is a serious problem something you need to do... no everyone speak perfect English.
The diabetes nurse at this clinic that helps with my care is expectational, she really cares and is so personable. She has really helped me and has made a real difference to my care.

Very little output from staff, they seem very undertrained and naive.
Poor service on a whole, needs intervention from an appropriate professional body.

Hello
Thank you all, especially for what you are doing for my husband.
For someone who would never even take a pill for a headache he has accepted that to stay alive and well, he must take the medication he has been asked to take.
Thank you all
Everything went fine until it came to getting the results,  my examination was on the 5th Dec, the computer crashed and I am still waiting to hear any results on the 2nd of January.

Been registered with this outfit for 38 years and in that time very rarely needed to make appointment. When needing an appointment as we all know hard to get. Recently needed a 6 month blood check (as directed by hospital) told to make a doctors appointment. 8 years ago sent a letter asking me to make an appointment to visit the surgery, only to be told upon arrival that the surgery did not know me - as I have stated been with this outfit 38 years. In sort when you really do need to see someone the answer is go to A&E so whats point of it all?

I felt very badly and needed urgent appointment with GP.
I came to GP practice in the morning and appointment was fixed very promptly. GP checked my condition and prescribed the required medicine. Staff in the practice was very careful and helpful.

I was extremely disappointed to find out that due to an injury I am not able to go take my flight, I was asked to complete a easyjet medical declaration tick box form, that it was going to cost £50 to complete!  I am outraged a simple form that takes 2 minutes to complete they are charging £50.

I asked the receptionist about the update on my request for an extension on my sick note. I had requested it 5 days ago and it should normally take 48 hours to respond. It was well beyond that time. The receptionist suggested that they had not received the request despite me having proof of it on my email. She ignored it and said she doesn’t know and that I would have to request it again. I’m meant to go back to work next week and my work and I haven’t been able to get a formal answer about the sick leave dates. The receptionist was patronising and even as I left she was rolling her eyes and laughing with the next customer in the line. I wasn’t rude or abrupt. I simply needed help.

I dreaded having to telephone for an advance appointment. Having been told that instead of being able to arrange one during the day when the 8.00 am scrum has ended, this is not possible. One must join the mob at 8 or do without. This,although it is a doctor wanting to contact me, and not me being a patient annoyingly requesting an appointment. I am now attempting econsult to thwart another dehumanising phone conversation with reception.

Unfortunately this practice never has appointment! Always ask to call same day for appointment and thought been on time to call never received the appointment. This is frustrating and disappointing. Although I have lots of health issue but fed up to call them. The staff specifically nurses and receptionist are so rude! They don’t support or help and just ignore
I’m very happy that I have chosen this Gp to be my doctor’s. Very friendly very helpful receptionist.

All of the Doctors' and the reception staff are extremely professional and extremely kind and understanding 

The doctor remembered to ask about my Mother's birthday celebration which I though was very caring bearing in mind he hie is seeing many patients each day 
I feel that my 90 year old mother is genuinely well cared for at this practise

I did a request on patches this week were I was able to discuss my symptoms, my request was followed up the same evening and I had a GP appointment the following day. I saw a GP who listened and had an excellent bedside manner,
tests were ordered and I was advised to contact the surgery if my symptoms worsened. I am not a regular visitor to the surgery but when needed I have always found the Doctors and nurses to be kind considerate and caring. I think that Patches is an excellent systems rather than waiting for a telephone appointment. I could not wish for better care or attention at the Warrens Medical Centre.

Was trying to seek appointment today.  Reception staff very understaffed. Had to wait half an hour.  Was trying book an appointment for the following day.  Told cannot do this have to call on the day.  The surgery response time for calls is not very good.

I was called in for my annual review. 
Consultation including bp and blood tests carried out there and then. My queries were listened to and helpful advice given.
Follow up appointment 1 week later, further constructive and helpful advice given. 
All in all, very straightforward and helpful.
Today I rang for help with a mental illness issue The lady on telephone was understanding helpful and extremely kind

Receptionist are all polite & try to accommodate a time that suits you . I saw a very helpful doctor who took time to ask me how things were going & listened to everything I said .  The surgery is always clean & welcoming . These doctors have been offering face to face appointments since January I don't think many other have . I have no hesitation in recommending this surgery .

I recently completed an E-consult form in connection with a problem with my hand. I received a response later the same day for a face to face appointment with a physiotherapist the next day. It seemed so sensible to see a physio straight away rather than going to a GP. The physio I saw was very helpful and explained everything well. The problem persisted and I requested a follow-up appointment. Again I was seen quickly and on time. I realise that there are often problems at the surgery but on this occasion I felt I should praise them for a good service which was much appreciated.

In general this is an excellent practice but I send the practice manager an email that wasn't acknowledged.  I sent it again and still haven't had an acknowledgement. Even if there's no comment on the content the email should at least be acknowledged

I have been with this practice since the 70's & seen a few changes but they have always looked after me & still do with the utmost kindness respect caring & professionalism - all staff & doctors from the top to the bottom treat me as a person not a number as I have heard other places do & above all I value the continuity of care so important at my age & complex health problems - they embody the caring ethic which should be imbued throughout the nhs - in the current political & economic climate one of my greatest fears is that the government are selling out the nhs & in effect leaving me to die alone & in pain - without this practice I would not now be alive to sing their praises to the highest possible level - they have saved me in so very many ways for so very many years – it feels like nothing is too much effort for them to make my life liveable xxxxxxx
I visited the surgery late afternoon for a copy of a med cert and letter, the receptionist was very helpful and courteous and made me feel very grateful and welcome.

After my 15 year old son experienced a sudden an very unexpected bout of I'll health , I can not fault the service at Greensands Surgery, Maidstone. From the receptionist to the doctors and everyone in-between our son and family felt very well supported and looked after. We can not thank you enough.

I attend the practice last Friday seeking to sort out my prescription,  the receptionist was extremely helpful and kind the issue was completed to my absolute satisfaction, this was done in the am period,please thank the person concerned.

Having visited this GP a number of times myself and my family, have nothing but praise for their professionalism in dealing with queries whether over the phone or face to face. 

Special thanks to the reception manager who is always at hand to communicate to the patients for any delays in seeing the reception due to busy times. 

Having worked in number of hospitals , must admit that this GP and its staff take efforts to provide a sustainable service to its area. 

Keep up the good work.

I am sick of this surgery, every time I need an appointment I get questioned by a receptionist about why they should grant me the wish of speaking to the doctor. Recently had blood tests as I haven't been feeling well, didn't hear anything back so I called as I am still feeling unwell. Receptionist told me nothing has shown up in the blood tests so nothing further will be done, I said but I'm still not feeling well, she then said what do want me to do, I said well I'm still not feeling well so what can I do, huffing and puffing she said well do you want an appointment, she made me feel stupid so I hung up. I will be changing Dr surgery for both me and my son. Absolutely appalling!

They never seek to help! Just try to get rid of you! 3 times I went about the same problem just ended up having an operation only took them 3 times to notice something was wrong. Today went in feeling unwell and dizzy and was given sickness tablets??
Always had excellent service. Appointment when required,  never had any problems. All staff very helpful  and call backs when required.

Always receive a fast response (typically same day mostly within an hour or so of submitting an econsult.) Reception are friendly and knowledgeable and the doctors and nurses are friendly, caring and show genuine interest and concern

This is a very good practice with amazing doctors the only problem is you have to ring up at 8am for a doctor to ring you back in the morning to discuss your problem and if you don't get through at 8Am then you have to wait till 1Pm in the afternoon for afternoon Appointments but except from that a brilliant practise
The doctor who was treating me was very attentive and listened to my concerns as well as putting me through a translator. They sought out my illness and gave me a good plan

An extremely sympathetic and personable receptionist spoke to me twice today regarding a sudden case of shingles. When the doctor then phoned she was also excellent, very kind and I did not feel rushed at all but listened to ; quite a skill over the phone. She worked out the closest chemist that would still be ope for me to get the prescription and get going on the treatment tonight and  then forwarded me further information about a research project via a text.I know that my previous surgery would not have provided that level of service and can’t thank the receptionist and doctor enough.

I have been trying to ring them about covid vax many times ..
i have been told that this Centre do the vax and this is the one i got to use , i given phone number as you have to ring for times and appt for vax , after lisening all the rubbish it tells you to press 2 to speak to someone then their phone disconnects you every time .. its not a fault with phone its the way they treat people ..

On arrival the receptionist was welcoming  and friendly, I saw the doctor on time and even had my blood taken without an appointment. 
Thanks for a great service. Chris w

Parklands have always been brilliant and despite the difficulties in booking a routine appointment since the pandemic, the receptionists always find a way for you to be seen either in the surgery or elsewhere if your issue is urgent. Highly recommended!

Booked to see Nurse who was running late due to a complex case in the previous appointment, the nurse asked one of the receptionist to let me know she was running late and would be as soon as she could… makes a big difference when you are told why you are waiting and of course understandable. The Nurse was then really lovely and apologetic when I saw her and very professional
Never answer the phone been trying for 30mins for good 10mins it went to user busy but then it was ringing and they still ignored the calls the receptionist is very very rude
When ever you ring .it all but impossible to get an answer .have rung on numerous occasions and always the sane response.ring ring ring no answer !!!! Very very frustrating to say the least

I’ve had two appointments the first one was with a health care assistant who carried out blood tests, blood pressure, weight and height. She was very friendly and efficient. My appointment was sent via a text to me. The appointment today was for the results of my annual check and was with the practice nurse. The appointment was again sent via text. I saw her on time and we discussed the findings of my tests. She was very approachable and efficient explaining the outcomes in a clear manner.

Everyone is so kind and efficient. Yesterdays visit was up to Manor surgery standards. I've been using this practice since 2008 and couldn't be happier with it. You've seen me through some times of poor health and I've felt supported and cared for. Thank you

I saw the advanced nurse practitioner with regards to my daughter, she was very helpful and explained everything thoroughly and clearly. I have also seen the GP's at this practice and cannot fault them. Reception are always very helpful.
My whole experience from start to finish was excellent. I didn’t have to wait at all and the staff were well organised and helpful

Having had a scan recently I tried to call to get results. After hanging on hold for two hours (I took a screenshot of my phone as proof) I finally became ‘caller no1’ in the queue and was then cut off! I called back and after a further 40 mins got through to be told the doctor was reviewing my results and would call me back the next working day. They didn’t call me back so today I drove to the surgery to be told the doctor was reviewing my results and would call me back, but no idea when.

Women working on reception are always rude. 
Using their mobile phone whilst you wait. No professionism or companion.

This practice makes things difficult from the minute you make your first phone call; prolonged queuing to get through, impatient, rude receptionists who are often judgemental and bossy, followed by always running late. They have no respect for patients & never apologise for keeping me waiting, often way past my appointment time. When you do get to see the nurse/ doctor, they rush you in & out and do not give chance to ask any questions.  When mistakes are made with prescriptions, they blame the pharmacy. No empathy or kindness. Receptionists need a lot of training, especially in courtesy, manners and politeness.
Received a message from The Ridge which was left on my answering machine. The message was totally incomprehensible. The caller made no attempt to speak clearly. Consequently you had to write to me.

Very good service received face to face  appointment promptly as regards time

Very constructive and  supported  listening by Practitioner  who  I saw  who recommended  appropriate way forward for me at this time  Thank you to 1 and all
It was only an asthma review but the nurse was fantastic and very proactive with my condition. Changing my medication to suit my needs and behaviour. Also a lovely person.

I was in a panic this morning as my 5 year old was very unwell, the receptionist was so helpful and put me on the triage for a call back. A very lovely GP called me back and arranged a face to face appointment later that day.  Thank you to all the staff involved, highly recommend this surgery.

i have not long moved to pilch lane surgery and have been very impressed with all the staff, they have all been professional, courteous, pleasant and should all be so very proud of themselves, and i have nothing but praise for them all, thankyou,
mrs brenda pears.

I said ‘unlikely’ that I’d refer friends to the practice, simply because I want to get in first! We find it extremely difficult to get an appointment to see a GP. My wife regularly holds on for more than 20 min at 8am in the morning, just to be told there are no more appointments. We are then forced to call 111 or use the A&E neither of which should be used if an in person appointment is desirable.
I had a pleasant chat with the nurse ,whom recommended that I increase my inhaler and she told me what to do if I have an attack.
Following your text I would to thank the staff for a splendid appointment today. All staff were pleasant,  polite and efficient. I would be happy to recommend this service any time.

Very supportive staff, receptionist was very polite and nurses were excellent and very supportive. My phone consultation with my GP was friendly, professional and life saving. I have never had a negative interaction with this practice.

I've been with Lonsdale for over 40 years and always had excellent care from the healthcare professionals. I've just had my annual review, which has been very thorough and efficient. In recent times, the much increased workload, and the national problems in recruiting and retaining capable staff, have put the admin systems under stress. But I'm very aware how hard the team are working to maintain a high standard of care and am grateful for their efforts

Have just moved back to Bristol and needed urgent care following an animal bite. On the day of registration the receptionists were so helpful and caring and the service was swift following a discussion with them at the desk. The doctor I met with was helpful, reassuring and kind. Really chuffed I registered with them and just wanted to say thank you to the staff for being so helpful to a gal in need!
My experience at Hartshill medical centre was top notch. The doctor was very calm, friendly and informative.

Very unhappy and disheartened about my trip to the surgery today . Went to collect a prescription for my husband who is going through cancer treatment . Was given something that is of completely no use to him and so i took it back to be told that they did not have what he needed and this was a substitute . I know that they do not always have everything in stock but why give him something for a completely different use . I handed it back in thinking that maybe this could ne reused for someone else as i hadnt opened it to be abruptly told ( well we will have to put it in the bin then wont we) . We have been shown mo compassion in a already very difficult time and very sorry to say that everytime i have been to the surgery or on the phone i have been treated with rudeness and disrespect and this is very much not needed .

I got the appointment within 24 hours from the time I have submitted an on line consultation. I was not seen on time and the waiting was 40 minutes. The Doctor was very good and he explained me very well about the condition and the cure . He further showed me the website and also provided the links . He has given  me 4 weeks time to try the treatment and to come back for follow up

3 year's an 3 split discs in bottom of back have picked my tablets up every 2 weeks on Friday cause Mrs put prescription in Friday just after dinner week before told to come back Monday im in horrendous pain without them ive tryed cutting down but is horrible pain without surely 10 steps and a signature would of prevented me going through a horrendous weekend ridiculous customer service thank you

Absolutely amazing staff at furlong cannot fault any of them, they look after my son with great care and the email service is very easy and quick. Would absolutely recommend! Doctors are also fantastic and very understanding.
good, quick service and had a very productive appointment. I was booked in promptly the doctor I saw was extremely helpful.

This practice used to be good but the last few years it has gone so downhill it’s unreal. Recently had surgery and was told I need my dressing changed by a medical professional (doctor/nurse) at least every other day as I’m vulnerable and high risk. After being on hold for 45 mins, a receptionist with an unbothered tone tells me they can see me in 6 days as they are too busy. so I have to attempt to do it myself even though it’s in a position I can’t reach or see and don’t know if I’m doing it right

Needed my husbands medication as we were going away and he had forgotten to order it. Called the reception and the receptionist went and spoke to dispensary who sorted it out within the hour. 
Both reception and the dispensary were just amazing, not only very efficient but friendly and so helpful. They work very hard and in my experience work tirelessly to meet the needs of patients.

I know people whinge about GP surgeries, but Hampton Medical Centre has been brilliant to me.  I have had a number of medical issues over the last year and on every occasion, I have felt seen, heard, respected and understood. 

From discussing and agreeing with me what an appropriate course of action would be (not just imposing) through to willingness to refer and to conduct certain tests. 

It doesn't matter which GP I see in the practice, I experience the same compassion and respect.  And the same for the nursing team and the admin team. 

I would definitely recommend the practice.

Everytime i have met with a dr or nurse for either myself or my children, they have been fantastic. Cannot fault them at all. However, the reception is just awful! My daughters vaccination appointment couldn't be attended as she was unwell, so i tried to call to inform them and reschedule. Noone ever answers the phone, 11 times i rang and each time the phone just rings out for 10 minutes then ends. This isn't the first time, nearly every time I have to call this happens and its just so frustrating. I understand they are overwhelmed with the workload and understaffed, but how can you not answer the practice phone?

I’ve been with the surgery for a few years now and I still hold them in high regard. Like many other places they’ve struggled to get back to “normality” since the pandemic and most appointments are held by phone, this is beneficial for me personally, however when required to be seen face to face there’s no issues with doing so. The doctors are patient, attentive and knowledgeable with what seems to be a genuine regard for your wellbeing.
Staff very helpful and doctor kind and understanding listens to you and a very clean surgery and would recommend it
Never had any issues with getting an appointment or phone appointment when needed. Staff are always very helpful

I cannot recommend Meadowview Surgery highly enough. 

The GPs are extremely thorough and meticulous and easy to access via the on line system in the mornings. The only negative is that appointments can only be made on the day but I've always been seen or responded to very promptly.

The practice management and reception team could not do more to be helpful and supportive.

Excellent in every way.

I have been a patient at this surgery for 41 years, and have seen a lot of changes in doctors and reception staff.  The doctors now are good some more through then others but the reception staff need either more training in customer care or upskilling.
Had both vaccine’s lovely friendly staff,  no pain really well organised, parking, booking in and being jabbed. No waiting straight through

Firstly it is impossible to make an appointment. Wait for 90 minutes on the phone to find out there are none available unless you wait 4 weeks or more. If you visit in person you are told you can't get an appointment, and to visit next day before surgery opens on  the off chance you might have a phone call and speak to someone. I have been attempting to resolve my medical issues in this way since last November. The results of a second X-ray are presently with the practice. I visited the surgery this morning and I have been told the earliest I can see a doctor was the 14th February. As someone who is elderly and is obliged to walk half a mile to the surgery and half a mile back I really do think that I am not being treated properly.
I have had a blood test done today and am really happy with the service and staff. I didn’t have to wait for my turn. Everything was quick and convenient

I have been registered at the practice for a few years now and have always had amazing service. Every time I call, I get through to a receptionist very quickly and I’m always offered an appointment quickly. The receptionists are friendly and each doctor I have seen has been incredibly helpful and empathic. I have felt so well looked after by this surgery!

I can’t even begin to write the amount of issues I have had since joining this practice in November 2020. It is one thing after another. I’ve had an appointment cancelled three times, that was only happening because a doctor told me I needed it and since then I haven’t been able to book it! And that’s just the beginning of all the issues: The whole system is ridiculous. All my household are with this surgery and every time one of us needs something it is a shambles. Once I get sorted what I need sorted I will be leaving the surgery to go to one that is such a mess.

Having been with this surgery 3 years I have never managed to get a face to face appointment with a GP, everything is done over the phone. The reception staff have absolutely no people skills, they are rude and impatient. You cannot order a repeat prescription without first physically going to the surgery to request it, have the reception staff demand the reason you need it, and then each time you request a repeat prescription you have to make a medication review appointment to speak to the GP before they issue the prescription, which invariably means you will run out of medication before the new prescription is issued.
Attended the Saturday clinic for my flu jab. Fast efficient and friendly service - didnt feel a thing.
I had a blood test on a Wednesday, the doctor called me with the result on Thursday and I was referred to and saw a Consultant team a week later. The service was brilliant throughout.

I have just had my flu and Covid immunisations. The organisation
(notification of the appointment, arrangements for optimal patient flow) and the clinical application were exemplary, as is usual for treatment here. ( I also have regular blood tests as I am on anticoagulant therapy)
Was called in for review of medication pharmacist very polite and helpful can't fault them always get in touch to suggest health checks for me. Good and caring people

My experience of this practice has been nothing but very positive. The GPs I have seen always go out of their way to help, going above and beyond what is asked. The practice admin staff have also been very helpful, when treated with the respect they deserve. 
I realise the building could do with some updating and as with many other practices’s, it is hard to get an appointment within a short space of time.

Rang for appointmemt between given times after long ivr message you select option for appointmemt it cuts you of. On continious replies it tells you appointments are fully booked but if you select another option to eventually get through to speak to someone do not expect compassion or someone civilised to answer the phone instead it's like a human dog barking at you. I made clear I understand no appointment is available but due to cancer related issue needed the ward number, the response was first "why are you calling this line it is a private line" "am just a secatery how can I tell you" nothing but kicking of and arguing and then they expect patients to not be rude or aggressive to them. Better of going straight to a&e.

I just want to say how impressed I am with your new telephone system. The call back facility means that contact with you is considerably less stressful than previously. Now, there is no need to spend a lot of time re-dialling before getting a ringing tone and then even more time waiting to get to the top of the queue.
Your operatives are as helpful and considerate as ever.
This new system certainly gets a 10 out of 10 from me.
Thank you.

can never get through on the phone lines,either engaged for 45 mins,then #14 in queue only to be told that you cant get an appointment in the specific women health clinic because they are full this month and they haven't opened the appointments for june.
You cant speak to a nurse on the phone either because there are no appointments and if you ring Wednesday or Thursday because the Women's health nurse that you need to speak to is there ,you probably wont get a call back because shes booked up.
so I say to the receptionist, I therefore cant book an appointment or speak to a woman's health nurse .
No,was the answer...and she also came out with.
"it's just one of those things "
Great service dont you think.

This surgery is still old fasioned ! They need to get the kiosk working again! They need to make sure they are more digital ! Its 2022 why are we still having lettera by post ???? We need emailed letters lyk other service we need text messages sent as soon as an appointment has been booked !!! The managers definitly need some digitial input into the surgery!

I have been visiting the Cheadle Practice for 50+ years and have always felt their staff provide excellent care and advice. I feel confident that I am now with a practice that has amazing communication between all departments and the hospital and I have already recommended St George’s to 2 other people. Reception staff are friendly and helpful (which is not what I have experienced in the past with surgeries!) and do their very best to help.

I’ve been a patient here for about 18 months, the staff have been nothing but brilliant. The receptionists are great, the doctor and various nurses I have seen are incredibly helpful. The econsult system works really well, I’ve always been able to speak to a Dr that day, and on the off chance a telephone appointment hasn’t been enough I’ve been seen within 24 hours.

Needed a fit to work abroad letter. Got an appointment with a nurse who was lovely. When I phoned to get the letter the reception staff were rude telling me they can't give me one and I need an appointment, although I had already had the appointment. Got a phone call from the doctor who said I need to see him directly because I need to have the tests done again and he can't give me one because he didn't see me. Wasted my time and the nhs's time. Always take over an hour to get an appointment and my call normally gets cut off after about half an hour.

Today I had an appointment with the Practice Nurse, which I was pre-emptively nervous for. However, in the care of Practice Nurse , she offered reassurance and was overall a kind and caring person. The appointment was made more comfortable by how she delivered the care!
Fantastic person!!
Phoned for repeat prescription to be sent to pharmacy in an emergency. But receptionist wasn't very helpful saying she can't promise that I will receive my medication.

I phoned the surgery to book appointment to see the GP for a suspected ear infection. I was told by the receptionist to visit my local chemist. I visited the chemist was told l need a prescription from my GP. I phone the surgery again to let her know l need a doctors prescription, the respond l got from the receptionist was to call 111, how can l call 111 for ear infection, it’s ridiculous  I am still waiting for appointment to see the GP face to face. I have been with this surgery for over 31 years, never experienced this hostility before,  needs immediate reform. Have no problem with the GPS, the receptionist needs good training and how to deal with patients.

I find the staff and Dr's to very friendly helpful and approachable. Although if you ring at 8am or 1pm there are likely to be long queues due to that being peak appointment booking times and I feel like there should be more staff on at this busy time as sometimes you call at 8 or 1 and by the time you get through appointments are then unavailable. Other than that a great practice.

I had an appointment with a heath care assistant/care coordinator. I did not have to wait long to book the appointment. I was seen on time and she was very friendly and efficient. Very good service. I think it is important that it is recognised when the surgery and staff do a good job and for the staff to be aware of positive feedback. Thank you

Ongoing health issues are dealt with caring and understanding this year. Rapid access to sympathetic and professional GP services via phone E consult and in person appointments and swift referrals for tests and other NHS services. As a patient I feel I have been listened to and received fantastic service

We got appointment the same day I called the practice - this happens almost every time I have ever needed to make an appointment and it’s something I really value and appreciate about the practice.
We were given advice and referred to specific websites for further details. I’m very grateful for the level of care we receive and would highly recommend

Had to ring as no email address easily accessible online. 
Hospital won’t send info to gp -‘you do it’
My time being wasted and reception team time wasted as having to ring up to tell them info. Can’t get through so given up.

I am finding it extremely difficult to get an appointment, I have COPD, have not had a spiro test for 4yrs or a peak flow for 2yrs, in July I developed a chesty cough, which to be fair I was prescribed antibiotics, but I still have this cough in September and cannot get another appointment..

Best gp practice fantastic Doctors, nurses and reception staff.
I am no longer a patient at this practice as moved out of the area, but wish I could have stayed with them, still work in the vicinity though, I always recommend this practice to my clients within my job role.

As I know they are in safe hands go above and beyond, do not rush your appointment and really listen to your concerns and involve you in decision making.

When needed will do home visits even though very busy.

Very good also with the homeless  I cannot recommend urban village practice enough, every Doctor here are compassionate and really do care about their patients.

I have been with Cross Deep Surgery since I moved to Twickenham two years ago to care for my elderly uncle - he has been with them for decades. In that time I have found everyone there to be not just very good at their job (they are), but open, friendly, accessible and helpful. There is very much the feel of a small clinic serving the community at Cross Deep - something which is sadly very rare at GPs nowadays. Everyone ; doctors, clinical staff, support staff, receptionists - the whole team - have been nothing but helpful, supportive and professional through what have obviously been very difficult times for both their patients and them. I have been with a number of doctors over the years. I can’t think of a better one than Cross Deep.

My go to GP is fantastic. I believe she cares and probably gives me more time than she should. She’s unlike other GPs.

The ability to leave messages for the GP through the website is also really helpful.

Not in recent times but on some occasions I have felt that the reception/triaging staff haven’t been very friendly and welcoming.

First it takes forever for the receptionist to answer the phone, secondly the good doctors at this practice have unfortunately now left. I had an appointment today and my new doctor was completely incompetent and suggested methods that's were entirely not within my budget. She refused to help me with the organisation of a blood test and spoke in a patronising manner. She then followed up with methods that required me to fork out money via a private route.

On a recent call to my Dr I could hear phones ringing and people talking in the background. As I was discussing a personal condition I thought it vet unprofessional that other people could obviously hear the conversation between myself and my Dr. I thought all discussions were private and confidential. I felt unable to discuss my condition in full and very embarrassed. I am thinking of switching practices.

Went to the GP for particular problem.  Something I said must have triggered a warning with the amazing young doctor who sent me for tests for a different issue and she was spot on!  The GP literally saved my life and I will be eternally grateful.

Very impressive service thank you - couldn’t ask for better. Everyone friendly yet professional 
Feel very lucky to have such a great surgery 
Thank you

I’ve been with this practice for over twenty years.  I find it very easy to get in touch with the surgery to make an appointment, order a repeat prescription or make a general enquiry.
All staff are polite, friendly and happy to help.  This surgery came recommended and it has never disappointed.

Every member of staff at Hartley wintney have been amazing….. they have been so helpful and kind when dealing with aspects of my complex health condition. I wish people could remember to be polite given there is such a shortage of doctors in this extremely challenging time
Thank you to you all

I have been on the Fairhill patient list for 25 years, and over that time have had excellent treatment and always found the team there helpful and courteous. Like many public services these days, it cannot be easy operating a GP surgery, and I can see how much effort the Fairhill team put in serving their patients. Yes, it is not easy to book an appointment.  However, with ever lengthening patient lists and workloads, and continuing difficulties in recruiting GPs, makes the surgery's job very difficult. But, these are issues that need addressing at the national rather than local level. As one of the other feedback commentators has mentioned, Fairhill compares very favorably against other surgeries, and I agree. Keep up the good work Fairhill team!

Really felt that I was listened to and the Doctor fully understood what was wrong with me. The Doctor took the time to deal with my issue and explain to me what was wrong and how they were going to help me.
